loans.SERIES_CODE: chart-volume, chart-rates, chart-mix — a series' identity when two match the same dimensions (longest wins)

loans.OBS_VALUE: chart-volume, chart-rates, chart-mix, chart-ltv, chart-pti, chart-loans, chart-slices, chart-terms, chart-consumer, kpi:volume, kpi:rate_ni_f, kpi:rate_cpi_f
loans.UNIT_MEASURE: chart-volume, kpi:volume — ILS series are scaled to shekels
loans.UNIT_MULT: chart-volume, kpi:volume — the 10**n multiplier of ILS volumes
loans.BS_ITEM: chart-mix, chart-slices, chart-consumer — housing / purchase groups / investment / reduced-price / home-secured consumer credit
loans.DATA_TYPE: chart-volume, chart-rates, chart-loans, chart-terms, kpi:avg_loan — volume, SA volume, count, rate, anchor, margin, term, PTI
loans.BIR_COVERAGE: chart-slices, insight:refi — new / new to refinance at another bank
